items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met her once and I was really overwhelmed, recent years, you know. She was at Antoine‘s. I went to see her, and she wasn‘t . . . she invited me to come to the hotel, so I did.

ctx.x: He was the organist, and there was a family of Bobby Tibbs, Bobby and Peggy, and I was just right there in San Francisco, and the uncle came up and said something to me.
You mean later on when you played San Francisco?
